trimmingSuggestions.description: The extended lightning effect and Olivia's long speech about shooting your shot feel redundant and slow down the video's pace.
Showing multiple tweets criticizing Olivia might feel repetitive. One or two well-chosen examples would suffice.
Kio's message could be condensed, focusing on the key points of Olivia's innocence and his plea for fans to stop the hate.
